stem: A shop obtains apples from a certain farm. It has been found that 5% of apples from this farm are Grade A. Following a change in growing conditions at the farm, the shop management plan to carry out a hypothesis test to find out whether the proportion of Grade A apples has increased. They select 25 apples at random. If the number of Grade A apples is more than 3 they will conclude that the proportion has increased.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: State suitable null and alternative hypotheses for the test.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Find the probability of a Type I error.

parts.label: (c)
parts.stem: In fact 2 of the 25 apples were Grade A.
parts.text: Which of the errors, Type I or Type II, is possible? Justify your answer.
